qa_flags.question: Karl Ackerman 追問 Q2 datacom outlook 中對 200-gig EML 雷射產能取得的假設為何
qa_flags.response_pattern: Seamus Grady 直接表明不會就個別零組件或個別客戶置評，轉而談公司整體 10 年成長紀錄，未回答產能假設的具體問題

qa_flags.question: Samik Chatterjee 追問能否將 Q2 環比增加約 $100M 營收的驅動因素排出優先順序
qa_flags.response_pattern: Seamus Grady 先說「可以但不建議這麼做」，接著僅列出 HPC／DCI／新電信專案／datacom 等多個驅動因子但拒絕給出排序或分拆比例

qa_flags.question: Christopher Rolland 追問 CPO switch 是否推升產能規劃、對比傳統 transceiver 的展望
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先表態興奮但明確拒絕深入：「we haven't really talked about the switch -- the CPO switch opportunities in detail」「I really wouldn't want to go much deeper than that at this point」

qa_flags.question: Tim Savageaux 追問為何 HPC 放量急升下，telecom／datacom 的 Q3 序列成長看起來反而放緩
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先回應「I'm sorry, Tim, I didn't understand the question... I missed the question」，未直接回答即轉交 CFO 給出量化說明

qa_flags.question: Samik Chatterjee 追問 CPO 對公司的具體 content opportunity 與營收貢獻時點
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 只給方向性用語「the specific timings on when the revenue would become more material, depends on our customers' road maps」，未給任何數字或時間點

qa_flags.question: Are you expecting that these programs stand-alone are like 10% of your revenue? Is it that sizable relative to the opportunity?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO does not size the new customer programs; redirects to a stated policy of only disclosing 10%-customer status retrospectively at fiscal year-end, never forward-looking, then closes with a vague reference to "a few other significant opportunities."

qa_flags.question: Do you believe you will be at the full run rate of the current HPC program in June? I think the previous expectation was March and June time frame.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO confirms the previously communicated $150 million quarterly HPC run-rate milestone will now be pushed out by about one quarter versus the prior timeline, framed alongside reassurance that the longer-term trajectory is 'stronger.'

qa_flags.question: I just want to ask a little bit more pointedly, if 800ZR in particular, drove an outsized portion of the growth this quarter or if it was more broadly spread.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO declines to quantify 800ZR's specific contribution to DCI/Telecom growth, stating it is 'more appropriate for our customers to talk about that,' offering only qualitative characterization instead.

qa_flags.question: How are you thinking about the OCS opportunity, and how soon can we see revenues relative to OCS products once engagements turn into wins?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO explicitly declines to opine on whether OCS is 'a winning product or not,' and does not address the 'how soon' revenue-timing part of the question at all, instead redirecting to general capability/comfort language ('very promising,' 'excited to work with a couple of our customers').
